pkgmetadata.longdescription: madc is a self-contained C and C++ compiler: it compiles standard C (C89 through C23) and C++ (C++98 through C++20) with its own front end and code generator, runs programs straight from source, writes native objects and executables, and opens an interactive REPL. No GCC, Clang or LLVM, no linker, no headers on disk: the C, POSIX and C++ standard-library headers ship inside madc.
